contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Trim Unicode White_Space from text. Return fallback unchanged only when that trimmed text is empty; otherwise return the trimmed text. Do not trim fallback. U+0085 is whitespace; U+FEFF is not.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh.

inputRoles.fallback: replacement used only for blank trimmed source

contract.outputRole: trimmed source if nonempty, otherwise unmodified fallback
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
